speaker: Doctor
text: I see. Since starting risperidone, have you noticed any involuntary muscle stiffness, tremors, or a shuffling gait that might make movement difficult? Also, have you experienced any restlessness or an inability to sit still?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: This restlessness is a classic sign of akathisia, a side effect of risperidone. Do you feel any internal sense of anxiety or urgency that drives this need to move, and have you noticed any other symptoms like muscle stiffness or tremors?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Recently diagnosed with schizophrenia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: College student, lives with parents. Denies tobacco, alcohol, or drug use.
